job.job_description:
We're looking for an experienced AI/ML Architect to lead the design and development of next-generation Agentic AI solutions for Healthcare powered by LLMs.

Join us in building the next generation of AI-powered healthcare solutions.




Data Science Engineer (AI/LLM)

Location: Chennai (On-site)

Experience: 5+ years in Machine Learning/Software Engineering and 2+ years in LLM Fine-Tuning




Skills We're Looking For



Python, PEFT/LoRA, RAG, and Vector Databases
LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Guardrails AI
Strong Machine Learning fundamentals and LLM evaluation experience
For the ML Architect role: AI platform architecture, MLOps, technical leadership, and team management



What You'll Work On




Fine-tune open-source LLMs such as ClinicalBERT and Llama

Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and Agentic AI solutions

Develop AI agents with long-term memory, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL), and evaluation frameworks

Implement AI guardrails, security, and governance

Design and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade AI platforms




Tech Stack

Python | React | Node.js | PostgreSQL | Neo4j | LangChain | LlamaIndex | Guardrails AI | Open-Source LLMs




Why Join Us?

Build cutting-edge AI solutions for healthcare

Own end-to-end product development

Collaborate with a high-performing engineering team

Solve meaningful real-world challenges using Generative AI

Ready to shape the future of AI in healthcare? We'd love to hear from you.
